verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a programmatic API with access tokens, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe of common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on every path. The spec could exist at a path the probe didn't check, so confidence is medium rather than high.
